verdict_summary.text: One SPHEREx exposure finds half of the artificial sources at AB 17.1 near 0.8 µm, AB 17.5 near 3.4 µm and AB 16.2 near 4.6 µm. The nominal Planet Nine of Linder & Mordasini (2016) would be AB 21.4, 22.8 and 23.4: 5.3 magnitudes too faint at 3.4 µm. Only the brightest published scenarios come within reach, and the planet moves too far between exposures to pile up its light without a shift-and-stack search.
